abstract: We report a case of retroperitoneal seminoma with simultaneous occurrence in the prostate. The testes were normal on physical and ultrasound examination. In this case a multicentric occurrence of seminoma was considered rather than metastasis from the retroperitoneum to the prostate. Systemic chemotherapy with vincristine, peplomycin and cisplatin was effective for the prostatic as well as the retroperitoneal lesion.
abstract_ja: 後腹膜セミノーマに前立腺への同時発生を伴った症例を報告する。身体所見および超音波検査で精巣は正常であった。前立腺病変は後腹膜からの転移ではなく、多中心性発生と考えた。ビンクリスチン、ペプロマイシン、シスプラチンによる全身化学療法は、前立腺病変と後腹膜病変の双方に有効であった。
